answer_2.quote: We evaluate our method on common language modeling and language understanding tasks including the Wiki-103, Enwiki8 and GLUE benchmarks... Our results demonstrate that factorization based pruning significantly outperforms block-structured pruning and even surpasses unstructured pruning... When pruning a large word-level language model with adaptive embeddings for example, our method achieves 50% compression while losing only 0.8 perplexity.
